reason: README provides sufficient evidence that the primary user-facing purpose is plugin-development tooling for DeepSeek Harness, specifically a provider of skill/plugin development and release-quality utilities (skill generation aids, compliance and security checks, dependency and bundle validation, and runtime probing), so it is classified as plugin-development.

summaries.zh: 这是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件工具集，提供技能沉淀、合规与依赖/恶意代码扫描、bundle 校验与运行时验证等工具，支持插件开发与发布流程中的检查与治理。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin tool package that provides utilities for skill creation and plugin release quality, including compliance checks, dependency and malware scanning, bundle validation, and runtime verification.

capabilities: Provides a provider package that registers multiple DeepSeek Harness skill tools via ctx.skills.
Supports plugin/skill publication quality checks such as compliance, dependency, malware scanning, and bundle linting.
Includes CI gate workflow guidance for build-and-gate verification in plugin repositories.

reasons.code: README describes the package as a plugin/skill tools provider and lists expert2skill, skill-compliance, dependency-scan, malware-scan, bundle-lint, and runtime-probe.
README shows usage through ctx.plugin(pluginTools, ...) and says tools are discovered from a line-level catalog for install.
README mentions CI template plugin-gate running build + bundle-lint + skill-compliance + dependency-scan + malware-scan during push/PR.
Repository description explicitly identifies it as a plugin tools provider for DeepSeek Harness.
